Paid submits can be replayed on network errors in generic clients
patterns: Prompt shorthand and typed key=value inputs

novel_features.name: Dynamic model runner
novel_features.description: Submit WaveSpeed model runs with prompt shorthand, typed --set inputs, local @file media uploads, price estimates, waiting, recovery-safe downloads, and library recording.
novel_features.rationale: WaveSpeed model IDs are slash-delimited paths, so a generated path-param command would percent-encode them; run submits to the literal path and never replays a paid submit.
novel_features.example: wavespeed-pp-cli run --model-id google/nano-banana-2/edit --prompt "a red mug on oak" --images @ref.png --set aspect_ratio=9:16 --wait --download 'out/mug_{index}.{ext}' --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it for any single generation; the prediction ID and recovery command survive every post-submit failure.

novel_features.name: Dynamic model schema help
novel_features.description: Fetch the live WaveSpeed model catalog and print the request schema for a model or project alias.
novel_features.rationale: Model inputs change weekly; the live schema is the only reliable source.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Check accepted inputs and enums before a paid run.

novel_features.name: Model price estimate
novel_features.description: Estimate WaveSpeed model pricing with the same input syntax used by run, without submitting a prediction.
novel_features.rationale: Pricing depends on inputs such as resolution and duration.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Free; quote the cost before spending.

novel_features.name: Media upload helper
novel_features.description: Upload local image, video, or audio files to WaveSpeed media storage for use as model input URLs, retrying stalled uploads with a size-scaled deadline.
novel_features.rationale: Model inputs take URLs; uploads are free so they are safe to retry.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Turn a local file into a URL a model accepts.

novel_features.name: Output downloader
novel_features.description: Download generated output URLs with directory, exact-path, or templated-path destinations, never sending API credentials to CDN hosts.
novel_features.rationale: Outputs live on a CDN that rejects the API Authorization header.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Re-fetch outputs from a finished prediction.

novel_features.name: Latest download shortcuts
novel_features.description: Print or open the most recent downloaded output.
novel_features.rationale: Iterating on images is faster when the newest file is one command away.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Grab the path of the last generated file.

novel_features.name: Project aliases
novel_features.description: Read wavespeed.json aliases, default model, and output directory settings for repeatable local workflows.
novel_features.rationale: Repeatable projects need short model names and fixed output dirs.
novel_features.why_it_matters: See which short names map to which models.

novel_features.name: Project init
novel_features.description: Write a starter wavespeed.json with aliases, default model, and output directory.
novel_features.rationale: Bootstraps the project config the alias resolver reads.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Start a new image project.

novel_features.name: Brief-to-shotlist planner
novel_features.description: Turn a free-text brief into a structured shotlist across platforms and aspect ratios with a hybrid deterministic-parser/LLM planner.
novel_features.rationale: Planning before spending keeps packs on brief.
novel_features.example: wavespeed-pp-cli plan brief-to-shotlist --prompt "Helm Black launch" --platforms instagram,tiktok --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Draft the shot list for a campaign.

novel_features.name: Model pick
novel_features.description: Recommend a model for an intent from the live catalog with rationale.
novel_features.rationale: The catalog is large and changes often.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose a model for a job.

novel_features.name: Cost estimate
novel_features.description: Price a shotlist against live /model/pricing and the account balance, with cached-pricing fallback and per-shot breakdown.
novel_features.rationale: Know the bill before a batch.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Check a shotlist fits the budget.

novel_features.name: Production QA preflight
novel_features.description: Pass/warn/fail validation of a shotlist: balance vs cost, model availability, prompt safety, platform request-shape, and brand coverage.
novel_features.rationale: Catch a failing run before it is billed.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Gate a pack before producing it.

novel_features.name: Multi-platform pack
novel_features.description: Produce a multi-platform creative pack from one concept at stable packs/<slug>/<platform>/ paths with per-platform manifests, concurrency, cost ceiling, and image-dimension validation; a rerun archives the superseded manifest.
novel_features.rationale: One concept, every platform, one command.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Produce platform-ready assets.

novel_features.name: Batch producer
novel_features.description: Submit many prompts from CSV or JSON with a spend ceiling and fail-fast/fail-tolerant semantics; records completed generations before any abort.
novel_features.rationale: Bulk production with cost control.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run a prompt list under a budget.

novel_features.name: Controlled variants
novel_features.description: Sweep seed, style, or model off a base shot to produce comparable outputs with side-by-side metadata.
novel_features.rationale: Compare options with one variable changed.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Explore seeds or models for one shot.

novel_features.name: Pipeline compose
novel_features.description: Run an explicit multi-step pipeline (text->image->upscale->video), feeding each step's output to the next, with rollback of later steps on failure.
novel_features.rationale: Chained generations without glue scripts.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Turn a prompt into an image and then a clip.

novel_features.name: Aspect re-framing
novel_features.description: Re-frame one image into standard platform aspect ratios, using outpaint when supported and an anchored re-render otherwise.
novel_features.rationale: Every platform wants a different ratio.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Make 9:16 and 1:1 versions of a hero image.

novel_features.name: Brand restyle
novel_features.description: Apply a brand profile or explicit style to an existing asset via img2img with a style prompt.
novel_features.rationale: Keep assets on brand.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Bring an asset onto brand.

novel_features.name: Generation library
novel_features.description: List, search (FTS5), show, tag, export, and cost-report the local generation library by brand, model, platform, and tag.
novel_features.rationale: A record of what was generated, with what prompt, at what cost.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Find a past generation or total spend.

novel_features.name: Brand profiles
novel_features.description: Create, inspect, apply, and edit brand profiles that auto-merge into pack, compose, variants, restyle, and run.
novel_features.rationale: Brand rules applied once, everywhere.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Set up a brand for consistent output.

narrative.headline: Run any WaveSpeed model from the terminal, with price checks, safe uploads, and recovery-safe downloads.
narrative.value_prop: WaveSpeed hosts image, video, audio, and 3D models behind one API. This CLI adds a dynamic model runner for slash-delimited model IDs, free price estimates, local file uploads, a generation library with cost reports, and a D2C content layer (plan, pack, batch, variants, compose, aspects, restyle, brand, qa). Paid submissions are never replayed, and every post-submit failure keeps the prediction ID and a recovery command.
narrative.auth_narrative: WaveSpeed uses an API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Create one at https://wavespeed.ai/accesskey and export it as `WAVESPEED_API_KEY`. `doctor` verifies the key with a free `/balance` read.

quickstart.comment: Verify the API key with a free balance read
Find an image-edit model and its price

quickstart.command: wavespeed-pp-cli run --model-id google/nano-banana-2/edit --prompt "a red mug on oak" --images https://wavespeed.ai/ref.png --set aspect_ratio=9:16 --wait --download 'out/mug_{index}.{ext}' --record --agent
quickstart.comment: Generate, wait, and download (local files work too: --images @ref.png)

troubleshoots.symptom: A run timed out or the download failed after submission
troubleshoots.fix: The prediction may still be running and is billed once. Check it with `wavespeed-pp-cli prediction-results "$PREDICTION_ID"`; the ID is printed with every post-submit failure. A failed download after a completed run is a warning (exit 6, partial_failure), not a failed generation.

troubleshoots.symptom: Upload of a large local file stalls
troubleshoots.fix: Uploads retry network errors, 429, and 5xx up to three times with a per-attempt deadline of --timeout plus size / 128 KiB/s. Uploads are free, so retries cannot add cost.

troubleshoots.symptom: price quotes more than billings charged
troubleshoots.fix: `price` returns list price; `billings` shows the charged price after account discounts (`order.price` vs `order.origin_price`).

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to generate or edit images and video with WaveSpeed models from scripts or agents: check prices, upload reference files, run models with waits and downloads, and keep a local record of every generation and its cost. Use the plan/pack/batch commands for multi-platform D2C content production.
anti_triggers: Hosting or serving your own models

recipes.title: Image edit with a reference, 9:16 at 2k
recipes.command: wavespeed-pp-cli run --model-id google/nano-banana-2/edit --prompt "$PROMPT" --images https://wavespeed.ai/anchor.png --set aspect_ratio=9:16 --set resolution=2k --wait --download 'raw/shot_{index}.{ext}' --record --agent
recipes.explanation: Pass a URL or a local `@file`; local files upload automatically. The download template names each output.

recipes.title: First-and-last-frame video
recipes.explanation: `--wait-timeout` bounds polling; on timeout the prediction ID and recovery command are printed.

recipes.title: Spend for a session
recipes.explanation: Billing rows carry the charged price per prediction.

recipes.title: Plan a campaign
recipes.explanation: Save the shotlist, then run `plan cost-estimate` and `qa preflight` on it before `pack`.
